base_observation: G3 owns the WP717 consumer repair. Existing VSR08 tests reject a direct non-factory binding and the independent VSR08A case strips the factory marker. Neither proves that a factory-origin marker alone is sufficient against post-factory structural replacement.

source_observation.factory_field: _factory_seal is a normal dataclass init field with default None
source_observation.deep_validator: validate_reentry_uptake_binding rebuilds the binding from the exact witness, uptake receipt, plan, selection, broadcast and cell_input and compares the rebuilt payload
source_observation.risk: Python dataclasses.replace preserves unspecified init-field values, so replacing a public lineage field on a valid factory-produced binding can preserve the private factory seal while changing lineage-bearing content.

setup: Create one valid binding with bind_reentry_to_uptake() from exact admitted WP507/WP508 source objects.
Use dataclasses.replace(valid_binding, broadcast_sha256=<different valid lowercase 64-hex digest>) without changing _factory_seal.
Bind a CortexEventPacket whose gwt_ref still equals the replaced binding.binding_id.
Exercise the WP717 G3 consumer validator intended to establish exact GWT reentry/uptake semantics.
failure_signature: A consumer check based only on binding type, binding_id, sha256 syntax and/or presence of the factory seal accepts the replaced binding as exact GWT lineage.
why_high_information: This distinguishes factory-origin identity from current exact source-lineage validity. It prevents a superficial VSR08 repair that only checks the private seal while retaining a mutation path that the existing deep validator was specifically designed to detect.
repair_guidance: For exact GWT semantics, reuse validate_reentry_uptake_binding with the exact source-lineage objects or an already-admitted immutable proof that is cryptographically bound to those exact objects and to the binding digest. Do not create a second GWT authority. If WP717 intentionally carries reference-only GWT metadata instead, preserve explicit reference-only classification and gwt_runtime_credit=0.
next_exact_action: G3 mutation owner adds VSR08C after the direct-constructor falsifier, verifies the pre-fix consumer is vulnerable if applicable, and ensures the minimal repair rejects seal-preserving lineage mutation before repository acceptance. Run repository CI before any new VPS promotion subject is bound.
